spec.rawSql: SELECT sum(pages) / 300.0 AS value FROM worker_samples WHERE at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
SELECT sum(bytes) / 300.0 AS value FROM worker_samples WHERE at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
SELECT sum(requests) / 300.0 AS value FROM worker_samples WHERE at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
SELECT sum(chunks_embedded) / 300.0 AS value FROM batches WHERE at > now() - interval '5 minutes'

SELECT (SELECT chunks_pending FROM api_samples ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1)
     / nullif((SELECT sum(chunks_embedded) FROM batches WHERE at > now() - interval '1 hour') / 3600.0, 0)
     AS value

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0), sum(chunks_embedded) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "embedados", sum(chunks_queued) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "enfileirados"
FROM batches WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Saldo do backlog na última hora
spec.description: Positivo: entra mais chunk do que sai e o backlog cresce.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sum(chunks_queued) - sum(chunks_embedded) AS value
FROM batches WHERE at > now() - interval '1 hour'
SELECT sum(chunks_embedded) AS value FROM batches WHERE at > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT sum(chunks_queued) AS value FROM batches WHERE at > now() - interval '24 hours'

spec.title: Páginas visitadas
spec.description: Inclui falhas, outros idiomas e páginas só de links.

spec.rawSql: SELECT pages AS value FROM api_samples ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT c.embedded_at AS "quando", p.title AS "título", c.seq, p.url
FROM chunks c JOIN pages p ON p.id = c.page_id
WHERE c.embedded_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.embedded_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT time, coalesce(family, 'total') AS metric, sum(v) AS value FROM (
    SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0), regexp_replace(worker, '[-_]?[0-9]+$', '') AS family,
           sum(pages) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS v
    FROM worker_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2
) t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((time, family), (time)) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, coalesce(family, 'total') AS metric, sum(v) AS value FROM (
    SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0), regexp_replace(worker, '[-_]?[0-9]+$', '') AS family,
           sum(bytes) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS v
    FROM worker_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2
) t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((time, family), (time)) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, coalesce(family, 'total') AS metric, sum(v) AS value FROM (
    SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0), regexp_replace(worker, '[-_]?[0-9]+$', '') AS family,
           sum(requests) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS v
    FROM worker_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2
) t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((time, family), (time)) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, coalesce(family, 'total') AS metric, sum(v) AS value FROM (
    SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0), regexp_replace(worker, '[-_]?[0-9]+$', '') AS family, worker,
           avg(cpu) AS v
    FROM worker_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
) t GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((time, family), (time)) ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval, 0), e.key AS metric, sum(e.value::int) * 60000.0 / $__interval_ms AS value
FROM worker_samples s, jsonb_each_text(s.errors) e
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Chunks embedados por segundo, por worker

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0), worker AS metric, sum(chunks_embedded) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS value
FROM batches WHERE $__timeFilter(at) AND chunks_embedded > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0),
       sum(pages_new) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "novas", sum(pages_changed) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "mudaram",
       sum(pages_unchanged) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "iguais", sum(pages_failed) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "falharam",
       sum(pages_foreign) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "outro idioma"
FROM batches WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT frontier AS value FROM api_samples ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, NULL),
       100.0 * sum(pages_new + pages_changed + pages_unchanged)
       / nullif(sum(pages_new + pages_changed + pages_unchanged + pages_failed + pages_foreign), 0) AS "sucesso"
FROM batches WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, NULL), avg(ms) AS "média", max(ms) AS "máximo"
FROM batches WHERE $__timeFilter(at) AND chunks_embedded = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Frontier e chunks enfileirados por segundo

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, 0), sum(frontier_added) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "urls novas", sum(chunks_queued) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "chunks"
FROM batches WHERE $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT lang AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM pages WHERE content_hash IS NULL AND lang IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT fetched_at AS "quando", lang, host, url
FROM pages WHERE content_hash IS NULL AND lang IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT fetched_at AS "quando", host, title AS "título", url, lang
FROM pages WHERE status = 200 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT at AS "quando", worker, pages_new AS "novas", pages_changed AS "mudaram",
       pages_unchanged AS "iguais", pages_failed AS "falharam", pages_foreign AS "outro idioma",
       frontier_added AS "urls", chunks_queued AS "chunks", chunks_embedded AS "embedados", ms
FROM batches ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 20

spec.title: Sites com mais páginas com texto

spec.rawSql:
SELECT host, pt_count AS "com texto", page_count AS "visitadas", priority AS "prioridade",
       round(rank::numeric) AS rank, blocked
FROM hosts ORDER BY pt_count DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT chunks_pending AS value FROM api_samples ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT url, title AS "título", round(rank::numeric, 3) AS rank, fetched_at
FROM pages WHERE status = 200 ORDER BY rank DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT sum(v) AS value FROM (
    SELECT avg(cpu) AS v FROM worker_samples
    WHERE at > now() - interval '5 minutes' GROUP BY worker
) t
SELECT hosts AS value FROM api_samples ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1

spec.title: Hosts na fila
spec.description: Hosts prontos para crawl: quase todos são hosts novos, descobertos por links, à espera da primeira visita.

spec.rawSql: SELECT hosts_due AS value FROM api_samples ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT hosts_leased AS value FROM api_samples ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(DISTINCT worker) AS value FROM worker_samples WHERE at > now() - interval '5 minutes'

spec.title: Páginas com texto
spec.description: Indexadas para busca. Estimativa do ANALYZE.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT round(s.n_live_tup * (1 - st.null_frac))::bigint AS value
FROM pg_stat_user_tables s, pg_stats st
WHERE s.relname = 'pages' AND st.schemaname = 'public' AND st.tablename = 'pages' AND st.attname = 'text'

spec.title: Chunks com vetor
spec.description: Estimativa do último ANALYZE de chunks, atrasa até uma hora.

spec.rawSql: SELECT ((SELECT greatest(reltuples, 0) FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'chunks') - (SELECT greatest(reltuples, 0) FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'chunks_pending'))::bigint AS value

spec.title: Cobertura do embedding
spec.description: Fatia dos chunks que já têm vetor. O resto só aparece na busca por palavras.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * ((SELECT greatest(reltuples, 0) FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'chunks') - (SELECT greatest(reltuples, 0) FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'chunks_pending')) / nullif((SELECT greatest(reltuples, 0) FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'chunks'), 0) AS value
SELECT pg_database_size(current_database()) AS value
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM hosts WHERE pt_count > 0

spec.title: Foco nerd/tech
spec.description: Páginas com texto de sites semeados com prioridade ou descobertos a partir deles.

spec.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * sum(pt_count) FILTER (WHERE priority > 0) / nullif(sum(pt_count), 0) AS value FROM hosts

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, NULL), avg(gpu) AS "uso"
FROM worker_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at) AND gpu IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, NULL), avg(gpu_mem) AS "VRAM"
FROM worker_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at) AND gpu_mem IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(at, $__interval, NULL), avg(gpu_watts) AS "potência"
FROM worker_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(at) AND gpu_watts IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Máquina: CPU (threads)
spec.description: Total da máquina, Bingus e o resto. 24 threads.

spec.title: Máquina: memória
spec.description: O Bingus tem teto de 32 GB dentro disso.

spec.title: Máquina: rede (enp6s0)
spec.description: Bytes na interface; o crawler baixa comprimido.

spec.title: NVMe livre
spec.description: Disco do sistema, onde fica o banco do Bingus.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT host, pt_count AS "com texto", page_count AS "visitadas", priority AS "prioridade"
FROM hosts WHERE host ~ '(^|\.)radar(gpu|cpu|ram|autos|dehardware)\.com\.br$'
ORDER BY pt_count DESC
